core_alpha_activation_gate.applies_to: team09-fcpc-center-v1 with root risk_policy.json in its no-control state

cost_output_contract.material_count_rule: Each policy is one material configuration whose organizer run emits base and doubled-cost outputs together. The two cost panels are not separately selected and do not count as two policy trials.

policy_materialization_rule: The frozen lifecycle reads only root risk_policy.json. The no-control core runs first. After it passes every activation minimum, copy any selected immutable risk_policies template byte-for-byte to root risk_policy.json before commit, registration, and run, then recompute every risk/source binding. Controls cannot rescue a failed core.

policies.hypothesis: Execution/control baseline with no enabled optional risk control.
Scale gross exposure from trailing realized portfolio volatility without exceeding the strategy request.
Progressively reduce gross after authoritative portfolio drawdowns of 12%, 20%, and 28%.
Close a symbol only after a 12% position loss is confirmed and block same-boundary reentry with a three-bar cooldown.
Cap one-way turnover at 40% per boundary to test whether signal churn is a failure mode after ordinary capacity and costs.
Combine volatility targeting, drawdown brakes, position stop, and turnover limit without side scaling or time stop.

registration_rule: The root no-control core is the first material preregistration. It must pass positive ordinary/doubled return and Sharpe, fold, bull/bear/chop, long-bull/short-bear/combined-chop, and sleeve-activity minima before any later policy may be registered. The five later policy paths are immutable templates copied byte-for-byte to root before their own commit, registration, and run. Controls cannot rescue failure.
